11.why: Each observed screen asks for exactly one main action: complete the two fields and press Continue.

12.why: After submitting, only a generic banner ('We could not complete that request. Please try again.') appears, and no success-state feedback is observed across repeated attempts.

14.why: The error message is non-blaming and suggests trying again, but it does not state the actual problem beyond 'We could not complete that request.'

15.why: No timers, countdowns, or session-expiry warnings appear on any screen, although no code-entry screen was reached to confirm entry time allowances.
